about: DEV set for task_router.wants_link: which requests start the tender <-> packing link. Written by the implementer on 2026-09-26 before the router change and used while building it, so it is NOT held-out. Items marked seen=true were phrasings an earlier probe had already run (the demo sentence, the existing tests, and ten probe phrasings). want: link = wants_link is true and the route is bid-parse / run; chat = the route's intent is chat (a question, whatever it names); other = wants_link is false (the request goes to its own post). The files in the requests are the SYNTHETIC demo files or made-up names.
